# Sinergitec

> Sinergitec Systems builds local-first developer tools. Our flagship product is **VoiceLink**, a Windows voice-to-text application that injects speech directly into any window (VS Code, Slack, Terminal) — privacy-first, with no cloud storage and no training on your voice.

Sinergitec is an independent Brazilian software studio (Sinergitec Systems), developed by danilofrazao-dev. All products are local-first: user data stays on the user's machine. The website is served in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

## Products

- [VoiceLink](https://sinergitec.com.br/): Windows voice-to-text with Universal Injection. Type into any window using only your voice. Local-first privacy — no cloud storage, no voice training. Includes high-precision audio feedback with a custom mini-spike waveform. PRO license: R$ 49,99 BRL (one-time purchase).
- [VoiceLink releases](https://github.com/danilofrazao-dev/Sinergitec.VoiceLink/releases/latest): Windows installer downloads and version history.

## Lab / demos

Interactive browser experiments published by Sinergitec:

- [2D Game](https://sinergitec.com.br/2dgame/): canvas-based 2D game demo.
- [2D Game (mobile)](https://sinergitec.com.br/2dgame-mobile/): touch-optimised variant.
- [Kaleidoscope](https://sinergitec.com.br/kaleidoscope/): generative visual experiment.
- [Flip Clock](https://sinergitec.com.br/flip-clock/): retro flip-clock UI.
- [Red LED Banner](https://sinergitec.com.br/red-led-banner/): LED-style scrolling banner.
